meta_description: Steven O'Brien Decorators in Leeds offers professional interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and complete house decoration. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decoration. We handle everything from fresh paint to complete room overhauls.
services_subhead: From interior refresh to full exterior renovation, we deliver professional results on time and within budget.

services.title: Interior Painting and Decorating
services.desc: Full redecoration of living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. We prepare surfaces properly, choose the right finishes, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting and Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint, soffits, fascias, and cladding refresh. Protects your property and boosts kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging and Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation on any wall, plus removal of old paper without damaging plasterwork. Includes pattern matching and feature walls.

services.title: Textured Finishes and Speciality Coatings
services.desc: Artex textured finishes, Venetian plaster, and specialist coatings for a bespoke look. Perfect for accent walls and feature areas.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality spaces decorated efficiently with minimal disruption. We work around your schedule and meet strict timelines.

services.title: Preparation and Problem Solving
services.desc: Expert problem-solving: damp issues, cracked plaster, uneven surfaces. We treat the root cause, not just cover it up.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home better than I found it.
about_para_1: Steven O'Brien Decorators has been transforming homes across Leeds for over 20 years. Steven began as an apprentice and has built a reputation for meticulous preparation, colour advice, and attention to detail. Every job, from a single bedroom refresh to a full house renovation, is treated with the same care and professionalism.
about_para_2: We don't rush. Proper surface prep is the foundation of any quality paint job, and that's where we invest our time. Customers return to us because they know exactly what they'll get: honest pricing, zero mess left behind, and a finish that lasts.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Steven came out and gave us a quote with no pressure. He was spot on with the price and completed the whole job exactly when he said he would. The finish is brilliant—walls are flawless. Would definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway redecorated. Steven's attention to detail is exceptional. He moved everything carefully, protected the furniture, and left zero mess. The colour advice he gave made all the difference. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior painted before winter. Steven worked through difficult weather and didn't cut corners. Fantastic craftsmanship, fair price, and reliable from start to finish. Already booked him again for the kitchen.
reviews.author: David L.
